profile.description: Matson, Inc., is an American shipping and navigation services company headquartered in Honolulu, Hawaii. Founded in 1882, Matson, Inc.'s subsidiary Matson Navigation Company provides ocean shipping services across the Pacific to Hawaii, Alaska, Guam, Micronesia, the Pacific islands, China, and Japan.
profile.description_zh: Matson, Inc. 是一家美国航运和导航服务公司，总部位于夏威夷州火奴鲁鲁市。自1882年成立以来，其子公司Matson Navigation Company提供横跨太平洋至夏威夷、阿拉斯加、关岛、密克罗尼西亚、太平洋岛屿、中国和日本的海运服务。
